name: first_sea_sortie_evidence_causality

evidence_rules.undock: Explicit Haven's Reach undock or actual departure from Haven's Reach proximity after a water-tap intent; navigation intent alone is insufficient.
evidence_rules.tap_to_sail: Water-tap navigation intent while not docked; does not certify that movement or arrival occurred.
evidence_rules.harbor_return: Actual Haven's Reach docking after observed departure and water-tap intent; player defeat or respawn are not prerequisites.
evidence_rules.cannon: Presentation salvo against a ship, not a monster; does not certify hit, damage or kill.
evidence_rules.harpoon: Presentation salvo against a monster; does not certify hit, damage or kill.
evidence_rules.repair: Input intent only; does not certify effective healing or shield recovery.
evidence_rules.local_observation: Record only when M289 accepts the local-development observation; never promote it into server truth.
evidence_rules.native_qa: Core completion is an observation milestone, not a native pass or release approval. Defeat/respawn remain separately testable without encouraging deliberate sinking in the regular journey.

placeholder_strategy: Reuse stable individually replaceable complete ship GLBs and external M290 presentation beacon; no modular ship construction.
